shared_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE brand-new full-scene postcard illustration for the original Sichuan countryside idle travel game “旅行癞疙宝”. Landscape 3:2 composition, requested 1536×1024, opaque full-bleed artwork. No lettering, captions, borders, panels, UI, logos, signatures or watermarks.
REFERENCE ROLES: The provided existing postcard images are the binding visual style and character identity references, not canvases to edit or compositions to copy. Create a genuinely different scene, with exactly the same recurring toad character, bag design, brush language, light and color family. Any separately listed isolated object reference is only a prop-design reference; do not reproduce its transparent backdrop.
STYLE AND IDENTITY LOCK: Match the existing gentle hand-painted storybook gouache / watercolor appearance with clear deep-brown contour lines, warm cream sunlight, olive / moss green, honey bamboo, cool muted stone and indigo accents. Toad is broad, low, stout, with fused head and body (no neck), half-lidded amber-gold eyes, orange bean-shaped parotoid glands, cream belly, a few clearly readable larger olive warts and familiar small facial marks, short rounded limbs. Same small indigo-blue cloth satchel with white flower on the flap, warm brass clasp, small red chili tassel at the side. Keep toad anatomically coherent; no extra limbs or human hands. No clothing or shoes on the toad.
LOW-SPECKLE RENDERING: Intentional economical painted shapes, not flat vector and not glossy 3D. Foreground leaves each have one main color and at most one broad shadow; grasses and distant trees read as large connected clumps. Stone and earth retain clean continuous base color with at most two or three soft tonal patches per broad surface and only necessary seams/structural lines. Keep key character markings but do not pepper scenery or skin with dense tiny dots. No gritty paper overlay, confetti-like highlights, unnecessary flecks, excessive tiny flowers, or noisy stippling. Do not achieve simplicity by blurring, bleaching or losing edges. Keep pleasing depth, softly modeled forms, restrained hand-painted material detail.
COMPOSITION: Environment occupies most of the frame, quiet breathing room, natural lived-in rural setting, toad about one quarter of image width; readable focal action and foreground/middle/background depth. Same calm, unhurried, mildly funny tone as the reference set, not a dramatic adventure or exaggerated excitement. One toad and one satchel only.

entries.title: 竹蜻蜓，飞一小截
entries.story: 两只爪爪轻轻一搓，竹蜻蜓晃悠悠飞了起来。才飞过竹凳，它就仰起脑壳看了半晌：再来一回嘛。
entries.scene: SCENE / NEW STORY: A shaded small open courtyard at Daoming bamboo country, bamboo grove at the left edge, a plain white plaster farmhouse with modest gray tiled eaves to the right rear, a low bamboo fence and glimpses of flat green fields beyond. Dry pale earth courtyard with broad cool leafy shade and a soft pool of sun. New composition: toad seated low in the LOWER RIGHT third, in three-quarter view facing up and left, satchel on dry ground close behind its right hip. A simple low bamboo stool stands left of the toad. The toad has just gently launched one little bamboo dragonfly toy: its two rounded forepaws have separated slightly at chest level after rolling the spindle; eyes calmly follow the toy now floating a little above and left of the bamboo stool, with lots of quiet empty air around it. Show the small toy clearly as exactly ONE horizontal two-bladed light bamboo rotor with ONE thin vertical spindle below its center, matching the isolated reference, not a living dragonfly or a helicopter. No motor, string, wings like an insect, or duplicate toys. Toy stays small but legible. Natural restrained sense of movement, no cartoon speed lines. Avoid copying the reference bamboo sorting table, piles of strips, nap pose or food. No people, teacups or additional toys. Preserve coherent contact of the toad, bag and stool with the earth. The image tells a small patient attempt at playing, not a high-speed launch.

entries.title: 蒲扇摇来一阵风
entries.story: 茶还烫，它先摇起了蒲扇。风拐了个弯，先凉快的是肚皮，茶碗倒也不着急。
entries.scene: SCENE / NEW STORY: Quiet Chengdu outdoor courtyard tea garden in a warm afternoon. A generous canopy of broad green leaves, a plain cream fabric sun umbrella at upper right, a low white plaster wall capped with gray tiles, two empty bamboo seats and a simple wooden tea-house doorway far behind. A warm bamboo reclining chair is in the LOWER RIGHT / CENTER, seen at an easy eye-level three-quarter angle; toad comfortably seated naturally, lower body supported on its seat, not standing tall. It slowly fans its own cream belly with ONE small pale straw palm-leaf fan in one rounded forepaw, matching the isolated fan reference: rounded heart-like leaf silhouette, restrained radiating ribs and short wrapped handle. Show fan tilted to the side of the belly so the cream belly and face remain visible; do not cover the face. Other paw rests loosely on the chair arm, feet naturally supported. The toad's familiar indigo flower satchel is on a small adjacent bamboo stool. At the lower left, an uncluttered low bamboo tea table holds ONE blue-and-white lidded tea bowl with lid resting slightly ajar; a single very faint wisp suggests warm tea. The cup is NOT held by the toad. Sense of slow cooling shade and an ordinary languid pause, no broad grin or frantic fanning. Floor consists of a few large pale-gray paving slabs with broad dappled shadow, not speckled stone texture. Keep upper / left courtyard open and airy; avoid replicating prior drinking, listening forward, or lying under chair compositions. No people, extra fans, snack clutter, mahjong, hanging red decorations or wind effect lines.

entries.title: 送片叶子顺水走
entries.story: 它把一片落叶轻轻搁在水面上。叶子转了个圈才往前走，它蹲在岸边，又送了好一截目光。
entries.scene: SCENE / NEW STORY: A peaceful little waterside landing along Huanglongxi's old riverside street, on a clear soft afternoon. New composition from a gentle elevated three-quarter angle looking diagonally across wide blue-green slow water, not the existing bridge-arch framing or the strolling street. Dry broad gray stone steps descend from the LEFT foreground to the shallow edge; two or three low white plaster / dark wood / gray-tile riverside houses and a willow occupy the distant upper-right bank, softly reflected. Toad sits safely planted on the lowest dry step in the LOWER LEFT quadrant, facing right, visible face and cream belly in three-quarter profile; satchel set one step higher behind it well away from water. One forepaw rests naturally on stone for support; the other short forepaw extends just beyond the edge after releasing a SINGLE natural ochre fallen leaf onto the surface, no limb stretching. Leaf is just below and to the right of its paw, separated from the fingers and large enough to read, gently cupped like a tiny boat but visibly a real leaf with one simple vein, not folded paper or a toy boat. Toad watches quietly with soft amber eyes. A few broad curved ripples show the leaf beginning to drift; most of the water is calm smooth connected color and simple elongated building reflections, not hundreds of high-frequency sparkles or horizontal flecks. Dry steps have clean readable stone seams and broad moss patches only near water. No rain, bridge tunnel, food, people, fishing tackle, sail, paper, litter, additional floating objects or extra toads. A tender little farewell to a leaf with plenty of calm water around the action.

entries.title: 给鸭儿让个路
entries.story: 田埂上来了一小队鸭儿，它把爪爪往旁边收了收。等最后那只慢慢跟上，它才背好包，继续往前晃。
entries.scene: SCENE / NEW STORY: Broad flat Chengdu-plain rice fields, narrow dry earthen paths, a quiet irrigation channel, distant bamboo and tree linpan clusters and a few small gray-tile white-walled houses on a LOW nearly level horizon beneath open blue sky and soft cream clouds. No mountain terraces or dramatic hills. New composition: a narrow ochre paddy path gently curves from LOWER RIGHT foreground toward the middle distance LEFT; water and tidy green rice clumps flank it. Toad is seated patiently on a slightly wider dry verge at the RIGHT third, its rounded forepaws gathered close to the body to leave a clear path, indigo flower satchel visible at its outer side. It watches exactly THREE small ordinary cream-white domestic ducks walking calmly in single file from lower middle toward upper left. Ducks have warm orange bills and webbed feet, closed wings, normal simple anatomy, consistent perspective; the rear duck has fallen one small gap behind the first two, echoing an unhurried wait. Three ducks clearly separated, not merged. They are small country animals, not humanized cartoon companions and no costumes. A few foreground long rice leaves create a soft frame but do not block toad or ducks. Field rows, tree clumps and clean connected earth planes supply depth. Toad stays broad and low with half-lidded attentive eyes, not waving like the existing granny card, not eating or sleeping. No human figure, straw hat, lunch bowl, poultry flock, farm machinery, props or red decorations. Keep mild patient humor and natural warm light, clear large painted shapes and minimal soil speckles.
